title: First warm-up: stretch, then 1-2-3-4
howTo: Loosen the hands for a minute.
Then the 1-2-3-4 finger ladder: one finger per fret, slow and even.

steps.text: Shake both hands loose, arms relaxed.
Spread the fingers wide, then close them. Ten times.
Frets 1-2-3-4 on every string, up and back down.
